title: Finite checks of the C generator ports
question: Does the compiled generator region match independent finite stream expectations?
reader_question: Does the C port generate the same keys as the reference models?
summary: Nine compiled generator modes match 144,000 finite model symbols and 8,192 archived Round 27 vector symbols exactly.
finding: 72 grid streams and 64 saved vectors pass symbol-for-symbol C parity; a separate checker independently constructs all 152,192 expected symbols.
limitations: Finite generator-port control only. No original PHP/glibc/Python 2 runtime, source scored decoder gates, native full engine, full seed space or LP2 manuscript search.
next_steps: Recover the exact language panel and establish platform compatibility before rerunning scored production-engine controls.
